newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland wants loose EU forest strategy - minister.
newsitem.headline: Finland wants loose EU forest strategy - minister.

text.p: Finland wants the EU to adopt a loose forest strategy which would be based on sustainable development but not disturb the forest economy, minister of agriculture and forestry Kalevi Hemila said on Friday.

"The target is to ensure and promote competitiveness of Finland's strong forest sector," Hemila told a news conference presenting targets approved by the government for Finnish forest policy within the European Union.
"The EU should adopt a loose forest strategy, which would include the main targets and principles," Hemila said. @
Finland does not want the EU to set a common forest policy, arguing this could excessively increase restrictions on the forest economy and distort competition on the sector, he said.
